label: Example: any OpenAI-compatible server you run yourself
notes: Copy this file to routes/<your-name>.json, put the name in models.txt, then run: python3 run.py check <your-name>. apiKey accepts a literal, $ENV / ${ENV} interpolation, or a leading !command. samplingParams is what pi actually sends; samplingParamsByThinkingLevel is supported too. With a llama.cpp server, the dummy key 'local' is fine.
